results: Cancel: raster, source hash and owner unchanged
Reset: original dimensions, all corrections neutral; invalid crop rejected
Apply: crop/rotate/flips/adjustments baked in memory; original file unchanged
Save As: all pixels match crop/transform/color reference; source unchanged
Unsaved guards: Close, Next, Drop and Open default to Cancel and preserve edits
Save: editor-only changes (rotations==0) save in place; No default; dirty clears
Animation: current frame edit warns; flattened result cannot overwrite original GIF
Export: edited pixels/dimensions, aspect lock, size measurement and new PNG verified
Color: right rotation, negative brightness/contrast and positive saturation match every pixel
